description: JOB DESCRIPTION – SOFTWARE ENGINEER Company: App Innovation Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Location: Coimbatore Employment Type: Full-Time Work Location: In Person Experience: 0–1 Years Location: Preference: Candidates from within Tamil Nadu only. Job Summary We are looking for enthusiastic and technically skilled candidates for the position of Software Engineer . The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of programming concepts, software development, application design, and problem-solving skills. Candidates will be responsible for developing, testing, debugging, and maintaining software applications while working on real-time projects and collaborating with the development team. Roles & Responsibilities Software Development Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications. Write clean, reusable, efficient, and well-structured code. Develop frontend and backend components of applications. Build and integrate REST APIs. Work with databases to store, retrieve, and manage application data. Debug applications and resolve technical issues. Participate in code reviews and improve application performance. Understand project requirements and implement suitable technical solutions. Collaborate with team members to deliver projects on time. Stay updated with emerging technologies and software development practices. Technical Skills Knowledge of any programming language such as Python, Java, or JavaScript. Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Understanding of frontend and backend development. Knowledge of REST API development and integration. Understanding of database concepts and SQL queries. Familiarity with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB. Knowledge of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts. Familiarity with Git and GitHub. Basic understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Good debugging and problem-solving skills. Tools & Technologies Programming Languages: Python, Java, JavaScript Frontend: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js / Angular Backend: Python Django / Flask, Java Spring Boot, Node.js Database: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB Version Control: Git, GitHub Eligibility Criteria Any degree 0–1 years of experience. Freshers with good technical knowledge and a willingness to learn can also apply. Good analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Passion for software development and learning new technologies. Important Note Candidates who have previously applied for the Full Stack Developer or Software Engineer position or attended an interview with our company within the last 6 months are requested not to apply again. Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹27,000.00 per month Work Location: In person
